title: Simple TCA/acetone protein extraction protocol for proteomics studies.
author: Angelo José Rinaldi

steps.title: Prepare 20% TCA solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20% TCA solution in a well-ventilated area using gloves and eye protection.

substeps.instruction: Add 200g of TCA to 800ml of distilled water.

steps.title: Prepare biological sample
steps.instruction: Place the biological sample into a microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 300 mg of sample to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Add detergent for cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 10% SDS detergent to the sample to break down cell membranes and facilitate protein release, optimizing the amount based on sample type.

steps.title: Remove cell debris and nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenized sample to isolate the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized sample to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Precipitate proteins with TCA
steps.instruction: Add TCA to the protein pellet and incubate to allow precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add concentrated TCA to the pellet to achieve a 20% final concentration (ratio of 4 parts TCA to 1 part sample; e.g., 800 µl TCA for 200 µl sample).
Incubate the sample on ice for 20-30 minutes.

steps.title: Collect protein precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample to pellet the precipitated proteins.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm at 4°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wash protein pellet with acetone
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet twice with chilled 80% acetone.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 80% acetone (cooled to -20°C) to the pellet, ensuring it is completely covered.
Quickly stir using a vortex tube stirrer.
Repeat the acetone wash a second time.

steps.title: Final precipitation and pelleting
steps.instruction: Perform a final incubation and centrifugation to recover the protein pellet.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the sample on ice for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13,000 rpm at 4°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Dry and resuspend protein pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and prepare it for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dry the protein pellet at room temperature.
Resuspend the dried pellet in an extraction buffer (10% SDS with 6.8 tris-HCl) or apply 10 µL onto an SDS-PAGE electrophoresis gel.
